subject: Acme - SOC 2 + Pen Test Evidence (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>, Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / audit evidence & next steps

Hi Sam / Jenna —

Thanks again for taking time this morning to walk through Acme's security and compliance needs. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum for procurement/security review.

Highlights / pain points you mentioned:
- SOC 2 Type II report required for vendor approval (critical)
- Audit log retention and export (need to confirm retention window and export format)
- DPA and any EU/UK Addendum for cross-border data concerns
- Pen test evidence summary and remediation history (high-level ok, full report redacted where needed)
- Timeline: security committee hopes to complete vendor review in 2–3 weeks

What I’m sending you now (see attachments + secure drive link):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report, redacted)
- pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (high-level penetration test summary)
- Draft Redwood_DPA_v3.1.docx (standard DPA with optional addendum language)

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll share the SOC2 + pen test summary and a secure folder link (attached).
2) Please confirm the required log retention window (you mentioned 12 months — confirm). If you need longer retention we can discuss options.
3) If the DPA language looks good, we can send a DocuSign for Acme legal / procurement to sign; otherwise share redlines and I’ll loop in legal.
4) Neha (cc’d) is our security lead — she can answer deeper technical questions about logging, access controls, and pen test remediation.
5) Propose a 30-min follow-up with your security/compliance team this Thursday 10:00–10:30 PT to close outstanding questions.

If that all looks right I’ll kick off the DocuSign and lock a follow-up.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / audit evidence & next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the materials. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: our security policy requires 12 months of immutable audit logs accessible for export. We may request up to 3 years for certain regulated datasets, but for vendor gating 12 months is the bar.
2) Exports: need CSV/JSON export of audit trails and an API endpoint for on-demand pulls.
3) DPA: please include the EU Addendum language — we have EU users and legal will expect standard Schrems II-compliant wording.
4) Pen test: high-level summary is fine to start. If we get past initial review we may ask for a redacted full report or an attestation.
5) Timeline: our security committee is meeting in ~2 weeks. If we can get the DPA signed and confirm retention/export ability by then, we should be able to move to procurement.

Confirming the proposed follow-up: Thu 12/23 10:00 PT works for me; I’ll invite our security engineer, Jenna is looped for coordination.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Director, Security & Trust | Acme Corp
sam.patel@acme.com | (617) 555-0908

Thanks Sam — this is perfect and aligns with what we heard. Quick update and confirmed next steps: 

1) Attached to this thread is the SOC 2 Type II report and the pen test summary (redacted). I've also placed the same files in a secure evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-acme-evidence

2) Audit logs / retention: Redwood supports 12-month immutable audit logs by default. We can discuss scoped longer retention for regulated datasets — that would be a configurable retention policy we can include in the Dedicated/Private deployment docs. For exports, we provide both CSV and JSON export via our audit API (I included the API spec excerpt in the secure folder).

3) DPA: I’ve attached a draft DPA (Redwood_DPA_v3.1.docx) that includes an EU Addendum clause. If that looks acceptable, I’ll send a DocuSign for Acme legal: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/fake-dpa-signature

4) Pen test evidence: attaching the high-level summary now. If your committee needs a redacted full report we can coordinate with our security team to provide an attested copy under an NDA (we've handled this with other enterprise customers).

5) Follow-up call: Thu 2026-12-23 10:00–10:30 PT confirmed. I’ll send a calendar invite with Neha on the call to answer detailed technical questions.

Open items for you to confirm before the follow-up:
- Finalize retention requirement (12 months confirmed?)
- Any additional DPA redlines to route to legal ahead of Thursday
- Names/emails of anyone else from Acme’s security committee you want on the invite

If you confirm the retention and that you received the attachments I'll kick off the DocuSign and add Neha as the technical lead for the call.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
